interface.longDescription:
A complete library of 53 marketing skills for AI agents, ported from Corey Haines' marketingskills (MIT). When you ask your agent anything marketing-related — write landing page copy, audit SEO, plan Google/Meta ads, build email flows, diagnose why a page isn't converting, set up conversion tracking, price a product, plan a launch, research competitors — the matching skill activates and gives the agent expert-level frameworks, checklists, and guardrails.

How to use: just ask in plain language ("rewrite our homepage headline", "audit our SEO", "why did our CPA go up?"). The product-marketing skill is the foundation: have the agent create `.agents/product-marketing.md` (positioning, ICP, voice) once, and every other skill reads it for context. marketing-loops and the operator references show how to run recurring marketing checks on a cadence with Kimi Code's CronCreate.

Compared to the original: all 53 skills and their references/scripts/assets are carried over verbatim (minus evals and the upstream tools/ directory of external API guides — links to it now point at the upstream repo). Claude Code-specific mechanics (ScheduleWakeup, /loop, WebFetch, `!`command`` injection) were replaced with Kimi Code equivalents or neutral wording.
